description: Read-focused, prompt-injection-hardened email MCP server for any IMAP provider
name: io.github.adamVass/pylos-mcp

environmentVariables.description: App password. Either this or EMAIL_PASSWORD_CMD is required.
environmentVariables.name: EMAIL_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: One of gmail, icloud, yahoo, gmx, fastmail, mailbox.org, posteo. Fills in IMAP, SMTP and Sieve hosts and ports.
environmentVariables.name: PROVIDER

environmentVariables.description: IMAP hostname for self-hosted or unlisted providers. Overrides the preset.
environmentVariables.name: IMAP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tiers beyond read, which is always included. Defaults to drafts.
environmentVariables.name: CAPABILITIES
